title: Sail Door County

services.name: Edith M Becker
services.desc: Come sailing on Door County's iconic registered tall ship! The Edith M Becker is a mainstay on the waters of Sister Bay. Join us for a 2-hour charter with our skilled captains and crew! Heave a halyard with the crew or sit back and relax as we shut down our engine and see Door County as it was meant to be Our iconic tall ship - Up to 22 passengers

services.name: Passage North
services.desc: Join us for a sail aboard the Passage North, our beautiful Cal40 The Passage North is a smaller, more modern sailing vessel. Available for public day and sunset sailing with a private option available for any scheduled Our classic sloop - up to 6 passengers

services.name: White Wings
services.desc: Join us for a luxurious private sail on the newest addition to our fleet, White Wings! About White Wings is a classic and beautifully maintained Pearson Rhodes 41'. Though any of our vessels are available for private sailing, White Wings is designated for private charters For private charters - up to 6 passengers

services.name: Friendly
services.desc: Join us for a 2 hour captain chartered sail on the newest member of our fleet, tall ship Friendly! This is a 6 passenger vessel (not including the captain) and is located in Egg Harbor at the Alpine Resort. Tours vary with weather, and the wind dictates our destination! No sailing experience is necessary as captain and crew are included! 2 At Bay Marine Sturgeon Bay Yacht Club - up to 6 passengers

includes: No sailing experience is necessary as captain and crew are included!

If the weather is bad due to high winds, lightning, etc, we will make the cancellation and you will receive a refund.
We reserve the right to cancel any cruise at any time due to extreme conditions deemed unsafe.
Do you sail in bad weather? - Sail Door County encourages guests to book early during your Door County vacation!

faq.q: Do you sail in bad weather?
faq.a: - Sail Door County encourages guests to book early during your Door County vacation! This gives you time to reschedule in the chance that we have to cancel due to inclement weather. Sail Door county monitors the weather at all times and we do not sail in adverse conditions. Should the weather be unfavorable, we will cancel.
